notes.title: Who is Abby – Major Update 1.4: Visuals, Performance & Polish!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.4 is Here – Experience Abby Like Never Before[/h1]

[i]This one’s big. We’ve gone back through every corner of the game and tightened, polished, optimized, and enhanced nearly everything.[/i]

[h2]⚙️ Major Performance Optimizations[/h2]
[list] 
[*]Upgraded from Unreal Engine 5.2 to 5.5 to take advantage of new performance enhancing features.
[*]Massive backend optimization pass for smoother performance across all systems
[*]Internal code improvements at all levels to support faster load times and better stability
[*]General framework refinement to improve runtime efficiency
[/list]

[h2]🌄 Visual & Environmental Upgrades[/h2]
[list] [*]Landscape tessellation added giving a more natural and immersive looking terrain in the forest areas
[*]Brand-new lighting setups across nearly all maps for better clarity and atmosphere
[*]Updated certain level design elements to better communicate narrative and gameplay goals
[*]Introduced new props to make certain areas feel more alive and visually interesting
[*]Added additional music to enhance the mood in key areas
[*]General improvements and refinements to the Museum environment
[/list]

[h2]🎮 UI & UX Enhancements[/h2]
[list] [*]Interaction UI fully reworked for better clarity and responsiveness
[*]Audio mix tweaks to sharpen environmental and interactive feedback
[*]Refined overall UX for a more intuitive and immersive experience
[/list]

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]
[list] [*]Extensive bug fixes and minor issues resolved throughout the game
[*]Fixed issue where you could fall through the floor after visiting the Storyline on Chapter 8
[*]Fixed interaction lock after using the PC in Chapter 7
[*]Improved controller support and fixed multiple menu navigation issues
[*]Fixed lighting bleed between areas that caused incorrect color tinting
[*]Corrected various subtitle typos throughout the game
[*]Increased consistency in visual effects, triggers, and progression
[*]Smoothed some of the edge cases that could cause confusion or unintended player behavior
[/list]

[i]Whether you're diving in for the first time or returning to uncover the mystery again, this is the best version of Who is Abby yet.[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1539260 style=button]Check it out on Steam[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.1.4 Patch Notes - Performance Boost & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.1.4 Patch Notes[/h2]

We’re extremely excited to bring you a new update which puts [b]Who is Abby[/b] to version 1.1.4! This update focuses on enhancing performance and addressing several key issues reported by the community. 

Here’s a bit of a breakdown of the changes:
[list]
[*] [b]Changes approach for non ray traced lighting on the final chapter[/b] which has massively improved the performance. [b]Note.[/b][i]We still recommend using ray tracing as the game just looks better.[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed multiple sticky stuck spots[/b] throughout the game.
[*] [b]Fixed Police station backdrop bug.[/b] There is now something to look at out of the windows. 
[*] [b]Fixed an issue with the museum[/b] not loading properly from Chapter 6.
[*] [b]Fixed issue where you see Tom[/b] in the boat before getting in
[*][b] Fixed Stocksynd House Achievement[/b] I wonder where you'll find that one....
[*][b]Fixed the “floaty Tom” issue[/b] in a later flashback sequence.
[*][b]Fixed an issue where players could light the fire[/b] from the attic in Chapter 6.
[*] [b]Many many other minor tweaks and fixes[/b] 
[/list]

It took us a little while to get this one out because of the difficulties with the performance issue on the final chapter for players not using ray tracing however, it is now resolved and runs considerably better. We managed to include a bunch of other minor fixes too. 

We still have more to do and we have a couple of exciting announcements soon... So keep em peeled! 

Don't forget you can follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cyberflux]Steam page[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/cyberfluxgames/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://x.com/cyber_flux]X (formerly Twitter)[/url] to get updates from us.

notes.title: Another Final Early Access Update - Who is Abby v0.8.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update for Who is Abby - v0.8.3[/b][/h1]

We're thrilled to bring you what we're once again calling yet another final update of our Early Access phase. While we've previously hinted at final updates, this update truly sets the stage for the upcoming full release... Probably. We've overhauled several core aspects of the game to generally make it better and prepare for the grand release!

[h2][b]Major Highlights and What’s New:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Prologue Level Completely Revamped:[/b] We've done quite a bit with the first chapter, packing it with new activities and a richer narrative. There are even a few rather cool secrets, but you'll need the full version to find some of them... ;)
[*][b]Additional Checkpoints:[/b] We have massively increased the checkpoint density across all chapters, making coming and going more enjoyable.
[*][b]Redesigned Menu:[/b] The menu has been redesigned once again. It now has a fresh and more simple interface that’s not only sleeker but also optimised for controller use.
[*][b]Settings Overhaul:[/b] We've expanded the settings menu with additional options, including the ability to select ultra settings without needing to enable ray tracing, hopefully providing top performance across a broader range of hardware.
[*][b]Player Sticky Points Squashed:[/b] Numerous points where the player could get stuck have been fixed.
[*][b]Refined Path Restrictions:[/b] We've completely revamped how player movement is blocked to keep you on the intended path without escape.
[*][b]More Inspectable Objects:[/b] Discover many new items throughout the game, each adding depth to the story and environment. Or just listen to Tom's jaded view about a toaster, for example.
[*][b]Increased Narrative Focus:[/b] We’ve enriched the storyline with added details that highlight the game's lore and enhance the overall narrative impact—as long as you're paying attention, at least.
[*][b]Puzzle Enhancements:[/b] Tweaks to various puzzles to improve cohesion and integration with the game’s storyline.
[*][b]Anti-Backtracking Features:[/b] We put in a few new mechanisms across areas of levels to prevent backtracking, hopefully keeping you moving forward and focused.
[*][b]100's of General Bug Fixes:[/b] Too many things to list but we've fixed tons and tons of bugs. An honourable mention is that the shed in the second chapter can no longer be passed through...
[/list]

[h2][b]Important and exciting information[/b][/h2]

We're genuinely excited for you to experience these improvements and can't wait to hear your feedback as we gear up for the full release. As always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm! Don't forget to join us on our Discord server for even more updates and fun stuff.

Additionally, the free playable demo will release on [b]June 10th, 2024[/b], and along with this, we will be announcing the official release date and pricing details for the full game. It's all very exciting!

notes.title: Final Major Update for Who is Abby - v0.6.3
notes.content:
[b]Hello, you gorgeous people![/b]

We're thrilled to announce the new and last major update for [i]Who is Abby - Early Access[/i], bringing us only a touch away from the full release. This update isn't just about minor tweaks; it's a substantial overhaul that enhances nearly every aspect of the game. Here’s what you can expect:

[b][u]Release Highlights:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*][b]UI Overhaul:[/b] We've completely redesigned the user interface to make it sleeker and more intuitive.
[*][b]Revised Chapter Maps:[/b] Every chapter has been adjusted; some feature entirely new sections to explore.
[*][b]Puzzle Enhancements:[/b] We've expanded or adjusted multiple puzzles to provide new challenges and deeper engagement.
[*][b]New Puzzles:[/b] Discover new puzzles scattered throughout the game world for an added challenge.
[*][b]Interactive Icons:[/b] New icons now display over objects that can interact with other items, providing clues and enhancing gameplay intuitiveness.
[*][b]Dynamic Objectives Display:[/b] Key objectives now pop up at crucial moments to guide you through the game, ensuring you always know your next steps.
[*][b]Cutscene Improvements:[/b] Multiple cutscenes have been overhauled to enhance storytelling and visual flow.
[*][b]Audio Enhancements:[/b] A plethora of new sound effects have been implemented, along with a complete overhaul of footsteps SFX to enrich the auditory experience.
[*][b]Music and Sound Zones:[/b] Music has been fine-tuned, and new sound zones have been added to enhance the atmospheric impact.
[*][b]Animation Updates:[/b] New mocap animations for actions like holding a lighter or phone add more realism.
[*][b]Performance Optimisation:[/b] Whether you’re playing in Ultra RT mode or Low Non-RT mode, performance has been optimized to ensure smoother gameplay and higher framerates.
[*][b]Enhanced Checkpoints:[/b] Added multiple new checkpoints throughout the game to save your progress more frequently.
[*][b]Shortcuts:[/b] Special shortcuts have been added to key locations to help cut down on backtracking.
[*][b]Anti-Backtracking Features:[/b] Various mechanisms have been integrated to prevent backtracking and enhance game pacing.
[*][b]New Inspectable Items:[/b] Explore and interact with numerous new items scattered throughout the game world.
[*][b]Subtitle Improvements:[/b] Increased subtitle font size for better readability.
[*][b]Audio Controls:[/b] Added a master volume adjustment in the options menu for better audio control.
[*][b]Bug Fixes and Tweaks:[/b] We’ve ironed out numerous bugs, including fixes for map points where players could get stuck, and implemented many gameplay tweaks to enhance your experience.
[/list]

[b][u]Pricing Note:[/u][/b]
A quick reminder, the current pricing is Early Access pricing, and the cost of the game will increase upon the launch of the full version. If you’ve purchased the Early Access version, you will have access to the full version at no extra cost.

We couldn't have come this far without your support and feedback. Thank you for being part of our community, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts on these updates!

While there will likely be a few bug fixes before release we do intend this to be the last major EA update. The next major one will be the full version release and we are very very excited to bring that to you.

Happy gaming,
Rory
[b]Cyberflux Games[/b]

Check out this video for more details.
[previewyoutube=ptpjw2fqNLo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Who Is Abby Major Update 0.4.7.4f3 EA: Road to Full Release!
notes.content:
Welcome to the latest update for Who Is Abby. After a few minor delays we are super pleased to bring you this brand new update. Its all very exciting as we pave the way for the full game release, we're overjoyed to introduce some awesome enhancements and crucial fixes that we have been working hard on.

[b]But first....[/b]
[h2][b]Important Note for Existing Players: 🚨[/b][/h2]
We have made some back stage adjustments to the control system and due to this please click the "Reset" button 🔄 in the settings menu. This will stop you seeing any control related anomalies during play.

[h2][b]Key Highlights:[/b][/h2]

[b]Storyline:[/b] 🗺️ We've added a feature to help understand your journey as Tom, hitting the Storyline button during the game will present a beautiful scene to help you understand where you've been and what you are trying to do. This should really bring something to enhancing navigation and story immersion.
[b]Major Performance Overhaul:[/b] 🖥️ We've made a huge update to the graphics and performance. Expect better framerates in both Ray-Traced and Non-Ray-Traced modes. Also, the non Ray-Traced modes are looking better than ever!
[b]Peaceful Mode: [/b]🛡️With the new peaceful mode enabled, it is no longer possible for Tom to come to harm within the game.
[b]Input Sensitivity Control:[/b] 🎚️ Adjust the game to your preferred play style with customisable control settings.
[b]Skippable Cut-scenes:[/b] 🚀 We've added the ability to skip cut scenes. 
[b]Zoom!: [/b]🔍 It is now possible to look a little closer at the items within the world. Keep your eye out for all the little details.

[h3][b]Enhancements:[/b][/h3]
[b]📲 Menu Overhaul:[/b] The redesign of the menu continues and it is coming together really nicely now! We even updated the Logo to make it a bit more readable
[b]🛠️ Huge UI update:[/b] We have redone many of the UI elements including fonts and control icons to make it look better and easier to follow.
[b]🔄 Updated Loading Screens: [/b]Slicker looking and more informative.
[b]💾 Additional Save Points:[/b] We've added more checkpoints.
[b]🗣️ New Dialogues and Sound FX:[/b] Lots of new bits and pieces added all around the world
[b]🚶 New Character Animations:[/b] Just a few tweaks
[b]🚶 More bananas:[/b] No not really, but I would of done if I was allowed.
[b]🛠️ Level Design Adjustments: [/b]A few areas have been improved for play-ability 
[b]⚡ Optimized Level Streaming: [/b]As part of the performance upgrade.
[b]🌟 Additional Ray Tracing Options: [/b]To make it a little easier to understand the settings in the menu.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes: [/b][/h3]
- Replaced the music in menu
- Inspectable items no longer reposition if use button is spammed.
- Fixed more areas that you might get stuck in
- Fixed multiple subtitle typo's
- Resolved issue with some notes having UV artifacts around them.
- Increased lots of dialogues volumes
- increased lots of inspectables inspect size


Prepare for a richer, deeper, and more thrilling exploration of Clearwater. This update is a big step towards the full game release, and we're excited for you to experience the enhancements. Thank you for your continued support and feedback. It's an exciting time for Who Is Abby, and we can't wait for you to see what's next! 🎉

We'd love to hear your thoughts on these updates! Please come and share your experience in either the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2614800]Community Hub on Steam[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/R7VhZPEqkm]Discord[/url]. Your feedback is invaluable to us.

notes.title: Major Update v0.4.5.4 EA: Chapter 5 and Lots More Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44685380/8b1c315a66bff06a9c5b060970294a57179f54b5.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

The last 30 days have been a whirlwind of activity at CyberFlux Games, and we're pumped to roll out a major update for Who is Abby that's live right now in Early Access!

[b]What’s New in the Latest Version of Who is Abby:[/b]

[b]The Big Changes:[/b]
- [b]New Chapter Alert:[/b] Bucking our original plans, we've dropped an all-new chapter into Early Access. Dive into 'Chapter 5 – A Sleepless Night' and let us know your thoughts. We're really proud of it and eager for your feedback.
- [b]Lost in the Woods Revamped:[/b] Based on your input, Chapter 2 has been completely transformed. Discover new engaging sections, elements hinting at the full release, and lots of other cool surprises. Your feedback was the catalyst for this overhaul, and we're excited to hear your take on these changes.
- [b]Ray Tracing for All:[/b] We’ve added a ray tracing toggle for those without the latest hardware. There's a handy test in the menu to check if your GPU is ray tracing-ready. If it isn't be sure to select Ray-Tracing disabled in the graphics settings and the game will still look lovely!
- [b]Menu Evolution:[/b] Our menu system is getting an update. It's not quite done, but it's shaping up to be more intuitive and streamlined.

[b]General Enhancements:[/b]
- Uplifted the in-game music with fresh scores.
- Polished cinematic scenes for heightened drama.
- Added gamma adjustment settings for customised brightness.
- General gameplay enhancements for improved flow.
- Performance optimisations for smoother play.
- Lighting enhancements for a livelier environment.
- Added a plethora of new wooden planks... and a few bananas for good measure.
- Refined level streaming tech for more seamless transitions.
- New dialogues and inspectable items for deeper immersion.
- Overhauled foliage for a more lush environment.
- Tons of little fixes and adjustments.

We’re buzzing with excitement to bring these updates to you and are keen to hear your impressions, feedback and thoughts. Your insights are priceless, so please, keep the feedback rolling in on [url=https://discord.gg/R7VhZPEqkm]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2614800/discussions/]Steam Community Hub[/url]. 

Here's to forging new memories in Clearwater!

[b]CyberFlux Games.[/b]

- [b]Menu Evolution:[/b] Our menu system is getting an update. It's not quite done, but it's shaping up to be more intuitive and streamlined.
- Uplifted the in-game music with fresh scores.
- Polished cinematic scenes for heightened drama.
- Added gamma adjustment settings for customised brightness.
- General gameplay enhancements for improved flow.
- Performance optimisations for smoother play.
- Lighting enhancements for a livelier environment.
- Added a plethora of new wooden planks... and a few bananas for good measure.
- Refined level streaming tech for more seamless transitions.
- New dialogues and inspectable items for deeper immersion.
- Overhauled foliage for a more lush environment.

notes.title: Patch notes for Version 0.4.4f2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Version 0.4.4f2 patch noes
[/b][/h2]
 - Fixed unpredictable behavior on forklift movement when lowering it (sometimes sinking underground)
 - Reworked graphics from the ground up, [b]Who is Abby is now fully playable on video cards not supporting real time ray tracing (RTX).[/b]

[b]IMPORTANT notes on reworked graphic options to all users:[/b]
 - We have added support to older video cards, so this extends the range of options for every player. You can access this new mode by going to Settings menu, and selecting 'Low' graphics preset. This toggles ray-tracing off entirely, and triggers the newly optimized mode to be active. 

[b]This fixes the game for:[/b]
 - Everyone who has been playing with low frame rates (25 fps and under) should enable this setting to stabilize gameplay.
 - Every player that couldn't progress past Brotherly love due to the level being rendered pitch black, can now continue to make progress and enjoy the game all the way.

[i]This setting should only be set for aforementioned users, so if you have the option to use ray tracing, please keep High or Ultra settings active in the Settings menu.[/i]

Thank you so much for the incredible support and feedback! 
If you encounter any discrepancies throughout the gameplay, please don't hesitate to reach out, we want to hear from you!

notes.title: Who is Abby 0.4.2 EA Update Released!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers!

We're excited to present our [b]0.4.2 EA Update[/b] for 'Who is Abby'. Your feedback has been instrumental, and this update is a testament to our commitment to refining the game based on your invaluable insights.

[b]What's New?[/b]
🔮 [b]Visual Magic:[/b] Experience deeper immersion with added visual FX and depth of field.
📺 [b]Crisper & Sharper:[/b] Native 4K resolution support for stunning clarity.
⚙️ [b]NVIDIA DLSS:[/b] Harness the power of NVIDIA DLSS for smoother gameplay, upscale/antialiasing support, and special Frame Generation technology (Nvidia RTX 40XX series).
🔧 [b]Your Control:[/b] Custom key mapping support to let you play your way.

[b]Fixes & Tweaks[/b]:

Many gameplay and save game refinements.
Visual enhancements and corrections - The big magic TV in the sky is no more!
User Interface and accessibility upgrades.
Added RTX test and acceptance screen to first time launch. (If you see the room, you're good!)

Your continued support and feedback have been tremendous, and we're dedicated to continuously improving the game, ensuring Who is Abby offers the best gaming experience. Dive back in and see the difference.

Keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us. We are working hard on the following chapters and we can confidently say that if you are enjoying it so far... There is some real treats ahead. 
Here's to the shared journey of unraveling the mystery of Abby!

Stay curious,
CyberFlux Games ❤
